profile.headline: Lead Customer Happiness Specialist | Technical Support Lead, Web Developer
profile.geoLocationName: Greater Los Angeles, California, United States
profile.jobTitle: Freelance Web Developer & Founder – Whittier Jiu Jitsu Club
profile.summary:
As a Lead Customer Happiness Specialist, I pride myself on my ability to build strong relationships with our customers and provide them with exceptional technical support. With over 12 years of experience in technical customer support, I have developed excellent communication skills and a deep understanding of the importance of customer satisfaction. I am highly organized and efficient, and am able to manage a team effectively to ensure that all of our customers' needs are met in a timely manner. 

With a strong technical background, it has allowed me to effectively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues for our customers. I am passionate about helping others and am always looking for ways to improve the customer experience. Overall, I believe that my combination of technical expertise and customer-focused approach makes me an asset to any team.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer & Founder – Whittier Jiu Jitsu Club
positions.description:
In the past year, I’ve been actively working on both technical projects and community-building initiatives.

On the technical side, I’ve been developing a BJJ Calorie Calculator Web App, focusing on JavaScript, front-end design, and user experience optimization. I also built and launched Whittier Jiu Jitsu Club’s website using WordPress, implementing a clean and functional design to support the gym’s online presence.

At the same time, I took on a large-scale project converting my garage into a fully functional Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu training space - Whittier Jiu Jitsu Club. This involved planning, budgeting, construction, and problem-solving to create a safe and professional training environment. Now, I host open mats, fostering a local BJJ community.

Through these experiences, I’ve honed my skills in web development, project management, and problem-solving, all while continuing to grow my expertise in WordPress, cloud technologies, and community engagement.

positions.title: Lead Customer Happiness Specialist
positions.description:
As a Lead Customer Happiness Specialist, I am responsible for ensuring that our customers are satisfied with our products and services. I serve as the primary point of contact for technical support inquiries and work closely with our engineering and product teams to resolve any issues that may arise. 

With a strong technical background and excellent communication skills, I am able to provide technical guidance and support to both my team and our customers. In addition, I am passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and am always looking for ways to improve the overall customer experience. I have experience managing and leading a team and thrive in fast-paced environments.

positions.title: Technical Support Lead
positions.description:
Provided exceptional technical support for the highly-rated and popular
WordPress plugin - WPtouch. Duties included solving issues, identifying bugs
and their causes, and solutions. Assisted customers with general WordPress
issues, theme customization, and provided guidance for best SEO practices.

* Provided highly reviewed customer/technical support
* Became Support Lead
* Trained other staff
* Head of Support Division
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), WordPress and +4 skills

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Was responsible for managing and maintaining a network of WordPress websites with a high traffic volume. The network averaged 350,000 unique monthly visitors and over 10 million monthly page views. 

One of my key responsibilities was to create and manage advertising and email campaigns. Utilizing a deep understanding of marketing strategies and knowing how to use various tools and platforms I was able to reach and engage large target audiences. 

With a strong background in SEO, using my knowledge of keyword research, on-page optimization, and link building I was able to improve the visibility and ranking of the websites in the network. My skills and experience allowed me to successfully drive traffic and conversions, resulting in increased revenue and business growth.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Google Adsense and +9 skills

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer Assistant Coach – Kids’ Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
volunteerExperiences.description:
Assist in coaching children (ages 4-6) in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, fostering teamwork, discipline, and confidence.

Help lead structured lessons and develop age-appropriate drills.

Ensure a safe and engaging training environment for young students.
